entities.name: Lathnu
aliases: City at the Top of the World
entities.description: A remote mining and aether-collecting settlement high on the Devra Cliffs in northern Avishkar.

entities.name: Devra Cliffs
entities.description: Cliffs on which Lathnu is perched.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: Capital of Avishkar, which Lathnu supplies with metal and aether.

entities.name: Great Climb
entities.description: Legendary final wall of mountains beyond Lathnu reaching to the heavens.

relations.quote: Lathnu is a remote settlement perched high atop the Devra Cliffs in the far north of Avishkar .
This constant supply of raw metal feeds Ghirapur's endless demand for material used in its countless devices and inventions.
